assertions.name: class_basis_is_orthonormal
assertions.note: column orthogonality: SUM_lam chi(mu)chi(nu) = delta * k!/|C_mu|, tested as an exact integer identity over every pair of classes

assertions.name: basis_is_complete
assertions.note: #classes = p(k) = dim L^2(Plancherel_k), so the orthonormal system is a basis

assertions.name: omega_is_diagonal_with_eigenvalue_sgn
assertions.note: e_mu(lam') = sgn(mu) e_mu(lam). THE QUADRATIC TWIST, in the form the Frobenius pairing puts it: one sign per class, not a global symmetry to be exploited separately

assertions.name: variance_is_a_basis_corollary
assertions.note: |C_{(p,1^{k-p})}| = (k)_p/p, so (k)_p^2/|C_mu| = p(k)_p with no character sum at all -- the sibling probe's Result 1 and 2 in one line

assertions.name: S_vanishes_on_odd_classes
assertions.note: (A) f is omega-even, so its expansion is supported on the sgn = +1 eigenspace. Half the coefficients are zero for free

assertions.name: S_at_identity_is_M
assertions.note: (B) S_{1^k} = SUM (f^lam)^3 = M(k), the normaliser of Q

assertions.name: weighted_S_sum_is_k_factorial
assertions.note: (C) SUM_mu |C_mu| S_mu = SUM_lam (f^lam)^2 SUM_g chi^lam(g) = k!, since SUM_g chi^lam(g) = k! delta_{lam,(k)} and f^{(k)} = 1

assertions.name: strengthening_S_mu_le_0_is_FALSE
assertions.note: S_{(4,2,1^{k-6})} > 0 for every 7 <= k <= 14, and is the largest positive coefficient in each. (B)+(C) make SUM_{mu != 1^k} |C_mu| S_mu = k! - M(k) < 0, which invites the guess that all of them are <= 0. They are not, so the conjecture cannot be obtained by proving a blanket sign -- it needs the 3-cycle class specifically

assertions.name: three_cycle_is_a_leading_mode
assertions.note: rank by |a_mu|^2 among all p(k) modes: {3: 2, 4: 3, 5: 3, 6: 3, 7: 4, 8: 4, 9: 4, 10: 2, 11: 2, 12: 4, 13: 4, 14: 3}. The conjecture's coefficient is a leading term of f^lam, not a tail

assertions.name: even_p_covariance_vanishes_termwise
assertions.note: Cov_P(log f, Sigma_p) = (k)_p/k! SUM_lam f^lam chi^lam(p,1^{k-p}) log f^lam (the mean drops out because SUM_lam f^lam chi^lam(mu) = 0 for mu != 1^k). Pairing lam with lam' makes the integer weights cancel for even p. Decided on INTEGERS -- and NOT implied by orthogonality, which needs both arguments to be characters; log f is not

assertions.name: float64_headroom_is_adequate_on_odd_p
assertions.note: worst measured |gross|/|net| over the ODD-p entries is 5.84e+04; double carries ~16 significant digits and the assertions below need 2, so the guard is quantified rather than asserted. The even-p entries measure 1.69e+17 -- total cancellation, no significant digits left -- which is not a defect but the reason section 4 decides them on exact integers and this table merely displays them

assertions.name: even_p_c_is_numerically_zero
assertions.note: the exact integer cancellation of section 4, seen through the float path

assertions.name: c3_is_near_minus_one_quarter_at_k_52
assertions.note: c_3(52) = -0.25031. The tempering derivative g'(0) of `qou-f4ye` is exactly this projection, so g'(0) = -1/4 is now a statement about one Plancherel Fourier coefficient of log f

assertions.name: c5_has_not_converged_so_the_pattern_is_UNTESTED
assertions.note: c_5/(-1/6) climbs monotonically to 0.617 at k=52 with residual ~k^{-0.64}; 95% would need k ~ 10^3. RETRACTION: reading the k<=28 table I recorded c_p = -1/(p+1) as FALSIFIED because c_5 sat near -0.075 and c_7 was POSITIVE. c_7 turns negative by k=48. The pattern is UNTESTABLE for p >= 5 in reachable k, and consistent with every datum -- not refuted

assertions.name: low_modes_explain_a_shrinking_share
assertions.note: 20.8% at k=12 -> 14.7% at k=32. Structural: single-cycle classes are k-1 of p(k) basis directions. A mode-by-mode derivation of g'(0) over single cycles works in a shrinking corner

assertions.name: gprime0_is_NOT_monotone
assertions.note: c_3(33) = -0.242668 -> c_3(34) = -0.242432 -> c_3(35) = -0.242351: RISING. On a consecutive grid c_3(k) oscillates (turning points near k = 35 and k = 43, quasi-period ~11, amplitude ~3e-4) on top of a downward drift. The merged claim 'monotone from below' in `qbeta_covariance_kernel_tempering_probe` and bean `qou-f4ye` was read off the coarse grid k = 16,24,32,40,44,48, which samples only descending phases

assertions.name: gprime0_CROSSES_minus_one_quarter
assertions.note: c_3(48) = -0.248271, c_3(52) = -0.250311, c_3(56) = -0.250614. The sequence passes THROUGH -1/4 between k = 48 and 52 and keeps going. `qou-f4ye` asserted -0.25 < g'(0), true only because its range stopped at 48. CONSEQUENCE: the argument for the limit being exactly -1/4 was 'monotone approach from below', and both halves of that are now false. -1/4 remains a TARGET TO CHECK A DERIVATION AGAINST; it is no longer supported as an infimum, and the data does not separate 'limit = -1/4' from 'limit slightly below -1/4'

parameters.claim: {sqrt(|C_mu|) chi^lam(mu)/f^lam} is an orthonormal basis of L^2(Plancherel) diagonalising the omega twist with eigenvalue sgn(mu); T_3(k) is one Fourier coefficient of f^lam

data._grade: decimal strings, float64-grade, 6 dp; see cancellation_ratio_odd_p
